newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil eases $2, spreads stable, volume low.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil eases $2, spreads stable, volume low.

text.p: European gas oil eased around $2 a tonne but spreads were little changed in listless trade on Friday, with some market players absent due to the Ascension Day holiday, traders said.
September IPE eased $2 to $171.75 a tonne, playing catch-up to Brent's late losses on Thursday.
Rotterdam refinery barges were discussed sporadically at September IPE -$0.50/$0.00, unchanged, but no trades were confirmed done in a slow morning.
Low sulphur diesel remained notionally at around $4 over the September screen.
"There are no real buyers ... German demand is almost zero," said one barge trader.
On cargoes, traders reported a 10,000 tonne parcel of German 0.2 percent sulphur heating oil sold on Thursday to British major at September +$0.75 cif Rostock for the second half of August.

Differentials on Thursday were drifting around screen flat to a 50 cent premium cif ARA. Low sulphur diesel remained around September IPE +$5 but with intermediate spec starting to be discussed it could drift higher over the next two weeks.
